# TS01-C4 — Stage-1 client orchestration — identity services

## What it is for

The client surface for the naming and oracle-adjacent services: registering names, and the linked-identity operations.

Talos is **the only supported client path**. Core modules build an unfinished bill that only Talos may settle, and the gas station sponsors **only** shapes it recognises. A core client function called directly would not have its gas paid and could not collect.

## Where it sits

Above the identity-service cores, at the top of Stage 1.

## Traps

**One operation here is deliberately free** — it takes no payer and collects nothing, while its three siblings all charge. It is safe because it is **bounded, not because it is cheap**: linking requires two already-deployed halves at real cost, and counterparts are never cleared, so it is one-shot per pair forever. That bound is pinned by a test. If counterparts ever become clearable, the operation stops being safe.

**One fee here is fixed in native units per character** rather than derived from a dollar figure — the single documented exception to the pricing rule, recorded as a ruling with an instruction not to "correct" it.
